clips.send: A real estate agent panicking about the market sends this to a colleague ready to quit - the true story of two Detroit realtors in the same recession, one going bankrupt and one getting rich on mindset alone, awe mixed with a jolt of anxiety about which one they're being.
clips.caption:
Zig Ziglar told this story about a strike at Detroit's Big Three automakers, and Kevin Trudeau calls it the best proof of mindset he's ever heard.

One real estate agent panicked - 85% of the town wasn't working, and he said another six weeks of the strike would bankrupt him.

The woman next to him, same city, same business, was thriving - laid-off couples finally had time to shop for their dream home, and she hoped the strike lasted so she'd get rich.

Same recession, same product, same customers. One went bankrupt. One got rich.

Which one are you being right now?

#kevintrudeau #zigziglar #mindset #recession #realestate #successmindset

clips.send: A guy setting a $50K goal for next year sends this to himself as a reset - the trick that dreaming in trillions makes six figures feel like nothing, awe at the size of the dream mixed with hope that it actually works.
clips.caption:
Kevin Trudeau says there's a difference between knowing about success and actually living it - and that difference showed up the day he sat with people running trillion-dollar hedge funds and sovereign wealth funds like Norway's.

The trick he took from that room: dream absurdly big first - $100 million, even a billion - then come back to reality and set your real goal, like $100,000 a year. Suddenly it feels easy, almost like a joke.

He compares it to coach Dick Vermeel, who drilled his players so hard that game day felt like a cakewalk.

Stretch your mind first. Everything smaller becomes simple.
